prompt: Alkoxymercuration-demercuration of an alkene with Hg(OAc)₂ / ROH, then NaBH₄, produces:

options.label: A Markovnikov ether (RO on more substituted C; alkoxymercurinium bridge prevents rearrangement)
A Markovnikov alcohol (same as oxymercuration-demercuration with H₂O)

explanation: Hg(OAc)₂ bridges the alkene; the alcohol opens the bridge at the more substituted C (Markovnikov). NaBH₄ removes Hg. Net: Markovnikov ether, no carbocation, no rearrangement — unlike Williamson, this doesn't need an alkoxide, so it's compatible with tertiary ethers.
